Siemens acquired Mentor Graphics in 2017 for close to five billion dollars. The deal was Siemens' largest acquisition to date. Mentor Graphics is headquartered in Wilsonville, Oregon. Satya Nadella is the CEO of Microsoft. Microsoft partnered with OpenAI on large language models. SpaceX was founded by Elon Musk in 2002. The transformer paper was authored by Vaswani and colleagues and evaluated on the WMT14 benchmark. Our new model outperforms the previous state of the art baseline by four points. This research was funded by a national science grant.
